endpoints.onset_anchored: alert within 240 min before the onset (secondary)
endpoints.post: same window, at or after the onset
endpoints.pre: matched alert 30-240 min before the breach and before the 1% onset

hypotheses.H1_in_progress_detection: pooled post-onset hits exceed the null; supported if Holm(3 methods)-adjusted one-sided p<0.05 under BOTH regime-matched and joint-circular nulls
hypotheses.H2_early_warning: pooled pre-onset hits exceed the null; supported if Holm-adjusted p<0.05 under EITHER null
hypotheses.H3_illusion: per method: composite significant (joint circular, Holm) AND H1 supported AND H2 not supported; generalizes if it holds for at least 2 of the 3 primary methods
hypotheses.bounds: 95% upper bound of pre-onset excess = observed - 5th percentile of the regime-matched null; 95% lower bound of post-onset excess = observed - 95th percentile

nulls.joint_4h_1d: same shift +-U[240,1440] min for all coins (secondary)
nulls.joint_circular: all coins shifted by the same U[7d, Lmin-7d] (circular within each coin window): keeps cross-coin dependence
nulls.regime_matched: per coin, each alert moved to a random minute of the same 24h-RV decile within +-30d, >=240 min away

per_coin_eval_start: max(2018-01-01, first UTC day with finite z_vol and z_hs + 1 day); coin excluded if fewer than 180 evaluation days
prior_use: none of the 2017-11..2019-12 coin-months were downloaded or evaluated before; BTC excluded (used in notebook 11); ETH 2020 was read in notebook 10 and is outside this window

procedure.calibration: coin's own 2022, notebook-5 calendar rule; budget per coin 20/month, 240/yr, 240-min cooldown
procedure.exclusion: a coin-definition with no 2021 training events is excluded for all methods
procedure.models_frozen_before_holdout_download: COIN_MODELS_FROZEN.json (sha256) written in phase 1, verified in phase 2
procedure.source: identical to notebook 16 (spec sha256 recorded below)
procedure.training: coin's own 2021 (minus last 245 min); label = breach of the coin-scaled definition 30-240 min ahead
